notes.title: Horse Farm Simulator v0.1.4
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone[/b],

In this update, the following issues have been fixed and new features have been added:

[list]
[*] Farm expansion bugs have been fixed.
[*] You now need to unlock Farm Level 2 before you can upgrade to Level 3.
[*] The car in your farm now needs to be purchased before use.
[*] New decoration items have been added to the market.
[*] A new tool has been added to the tab panel: Move Tool. You can now rearrange the café, your field, and other decorations.
[*] The issue where the fridge turned red has been resolved.
[*] The bug where customers' trash would fall endlessly has been fixed.
[*] When customers queue at the café, all their requests are now visible above them—not just the one in front—and you can serve them in any order.
[*] Donuts appeared to be floating slightly; their positions have been adjusted and grounded properly.
[/list]

Other missing features and bugs will continue to be fixed gradually through regular updates. I'm working to make the game the best it can be. Feel free to share your feedback with me.

Stay tuned and keep up with the latest updates![/h3][/b]

notes.title: Early Access – Explanation for Missing Features and Bugs
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]

I just want to share something with you all. I'm fully aware of the current bugs and missing features in the game. Please rest assured that I'm working hard to fix them as quickly as possible.

I'm putting a lot of effort into making this game the best it can be. However, since I’m developing it alone and it’s still in Early Access, I kindly ask for your patience and understanding during this stage.

My goal is to make this one of the best horse and farm simulation games available on Steam. And to achieve that, I truly need your constructive feedback.

Please know that your money is not being wasted — I’m committed to delivering value. I’m actively working on expanding the game with new features like improved farm customization, more café options and products, horse personalization, and much more.

I’m also planning to share a roadmap soon to give you a clearer idea of what’s coming next.

I appreciate you all and look forward to your constructive feedback to help shape this game into something great.

With love❤️

[b][h3]
Stay tuned and keep up with the latest updates![/h3][/b]

See you soon!

notes.title: Horse Farm Simulator v0.1.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone[/b],

In this update, the following issues have been fixed and new features have been added:

[list]
[*] The bug in the horseshoe mechanic has been fixed; now you can put horseshoes on your horses.
[*] Missing translations have been completed. If you notice any missing ones, feel free to share them with us.
[*] Info panels have been added for some confusing situations in the game.
[*] Your horses can now get sick. Don’t forget to feed and clean them regularly.
[*] The issue with horses not being fed properly has been mostly resolved, but it will be reviewed again in future updates.
[*] Errors in the feed production part have been fixed.
[*] The pink color of the horse feed has been changed.
[*] A “Save and Exit” button has been added when you press the ESC key during gameplay.
[*] The auto-save system runs at the start of each day.
[*] The bug causing the horse’s color to turn white has been fixed.
[*] Sound effects have been added to the grooming mechanic.
[*] The horse’s speed now changes depending on the horseshoes you put on.
[*] Your field and produced feed are now saved. They will be present on the scene when you re-enter the game.
[*] Products placed on the shelves in your café are now saved. However, products left outside are not currently saved.
[/list]

Other missing features and bugs will continue to be fixed gradually through regular updates. I'm working to make the game the best it can be. Feel free to share your feedback with me.

notes.title: Are you ready? HFS is coming on May 19!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

[h3]After a long time of hard work, our game is finally ready to meet you! 🎉 We've set our release date for [h2][b]May 19, 2025[/b][/h2] and we're incredibly excited to share this news with you. 🗓️💫[/h3]

[b][h3]In our Early Access version, we've prepared many new features and improvements for you. Here are some of the things waiting for you in the game:[/h3][/b]

[b][list]
[*] A marketplace has been added to the town! You can now buy products without paying shipping fees. It takes a bit more time, but it’s wallet-friendly. 🌿
[*] A casino/bar has opened in town. Perfect for those who want to unwind after a long day. 🎲
[*] Tired of your rundown house? There's now a new house you can buy in town. 🏠
[*] Empty delivery boxes now disappear automatically. No more clutter! 📦
[*] The settings menu has been completely redesigned. ⚙️
[*] A save system has been added—your progress is now safe. 💾
[*] Tired of handling all the customers yourself? You can now hire new workers. 👩‍🌾
[*] Start farming by growing crops like carrots and wheat. 🌾
[*] Train your horses and join races. 🐎
[*] Maintenance systems like saddle and horseshoe changes, grooming, and washing have been added. 🧼
[*] Saddle equip/unequip mechanics are now available. 🪶
[*] The farm expansion feature is now active. 📐
[*] With the new map system, you can explore the area more easily. 🗺️
[*] You can now rename your farm however you like. ✍️
[*] Take out loans from the bank to speed up your investments. 💰
[/list][/b]

[h3][b]And this is just the beginning! We’ll continue improving our game with the help of your feedback.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051301/3d508cb142b529e884af38bdeaaaae7e068b91e9.png[/img]

[h3]By the way, we've updated the capsule image on our game's Steam page. We believe the new visual better reflects the spirit of the game. We hope you'll like it too![/h3]

🗓️ [h3][b]See you on May 19[/b]! Take care and stay tuned![/h3]

notes.title: Demo Patch v1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Horse Farm Simulator Demo.[/h2]

[b]This is the demo patch v1.1 that includes:[/b]

[b][list]
[*] The issue where horses would get stuck in the riding area has been resolved.
[*] The bug where customers got stuck at the farm entrance has been fixed.
[*] The limits on two tasks have been reduced: the task to host 50 customers and the task to sell 20 toasts. Now, you only need to host 35 customers and sell 15 toasts.
[*] The outline for cooked toast was missing, and this has been fixed.
[*] Some translation errors have been corrected. If you notice any missing or incorrect translations, please let us know and we'll fix them. We appreciate your help.
[*] A bug related to sending horses to the stable has been fixed. When you interact with a horse and tell it to go to the stable, it will now go to an empty stable and, if there is food and water, it will consume them.
[*] If your horses are hungry or thirsty, you should send them to the stable and fill the stable with food and water, or you can give them hay or carrots directly.
[*] Now, when you go to sleep, your farm will automatically close, and any waiting customers will leave.
[*] Sound effects have been added when working with the pitchfork.
[*] A new patch update will be coming soon, and we are continuing to address the remaining issues.
[/list][/b]

[h3]
If you share any issues you encounter with us on Discord or our Steam community, we will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/UEBJvsQ5nZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051301/86a4e3f6e278083196166fa5a4402069ccdf4b68.png[/img][/url]
[b][h3]
Continue to follow us and stay updated on the developments![/h3][/b]

See you soon! 
[b]Glow Egg Games[/b]

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Horse Farm Simulator Demo.[/h2]

[b]This is the demo update v1.0 that includes:[/b]

[b][h3]
[list]
[*] The environment has been changed, new structures have been added.
[*] You now start the game with two horses.
[*] Guide signs have been added.
[*] A training feature has been added, allowing you to practice.
[*] Cargo boxes can be thrown in the trash.
[*] A mechanic for collecting hay with a pitchfork has been added.
[*] A car has been added to the game; you can load hay onto the car and bring it to the farm.
[*] You can sit on benches to calmly enjoy the surroundings.
[*] The delivery fee has been reduced.
[*] The game’s background music has been removed and replaced with ambient sounds.
[*] A small gate has been added for entry into the farm.
[*] The size of the horse has been slightly increased.
[*] You can hit the customers with a bat.
[*] New customer models have been added.
[*] A temporary fix has been applied for the map falling bug :)
[*] The speed of the day has been slightly reduced.
[*] You can set a price by clicking on the sign at the horse riding area.
[*] Missing translations have been completed.
[*] A new product has been added to the café: orange juice. You can make and sell orange juice using a blender with oranges.
[*] 2 new achievements have been added.
[*] You can now directly give products to the horse with the cargo boxes. It’s not necessary to put them in the storage first, but you can if you want.
[*] The horse no longer gets sick immediately.
[*] We have addressed and fixed the issues reported on Discord and the Steam discussions section as much as possible.
[/list][/h3][/b]

[u]Note: If you encounter any issues with launching the demo, please uninstall the game from your computer and reinstall it. If the problem persists, let us know.[/u]

[h3]
If you share any issues you encounter with us on Discord or our Steam community, we will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/UEBJvsQ5nZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051301/86a4e3f6e278083196166fa5a4402069ccdf4b68.png[/img][/url]
[b][h3]
Continue to follow us and stay updated on the developments![/h3][/b]

See you soon! 
[b]Glow Egg Games[/b]

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.2.4
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Horse Farm Simulator Demo.[/h2]

[b]This is the demo patch v0.2.4 that includes:[/b]

[b][list]
[*] The bug where you get stuck after exiting the computer has been fixed.
[*] The bug where achievements wouldn't unlock has been fixed.
[*] Some missing translations have been completed, and we will finish the remaining ones as soon as possible.
[*] Customers now leave plastic water bottle trash around after ordering water.
[*] A limit has been added to the pricing on the café pricing screen.
[*] Horses now leave droppings when they are sick, and you can throw the droppings using a shovel.
[*] The bug where boxes purchased from the market would end up on top of the cabin has been fixed; they now land on the ground at the entrance.
[*] The bug where customers would get stuck at the entrance gate when entering the farm has been fixed.
[*] The bug where players couldn't sleep after midnight has been fixed; you can now sleep between 7:00 PM and 7:00 AM.
[/list][/b]

[h3]
If you share any issues you encounter with us on Discord or our Steam community, we will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.[/h3]
